meta_frameworks.name: UNCERTAINTY
meta_frameworks.description: Limits of prediction, randomness, probabilistic reality, and unknown outcomes.

meta_frameworks.name: FRAGILITY
meta_frameworks.description: Sensitivity of systems to volatility, disorder, leverage, and cascading failures.

meta_frameworks.name: COMPOUNDING
meta_frameworks.description: Long-term accumulation processes driven by survival, time, and incremental change.

meta_frameworks.name: EXPECTATIONS
meta_frameworks.description: Reference dependence, satisfaction dynamics, envy, and emotional comparison.

meta_frameworks.name: NARRATIVES
meta_frameworks.description: Stories, emotional persuasion, collective attention, and cognitive compression.

meta_frameworks.name: INCENTIVES
meta_frameworks.description: Behavioral adaptation driven by rewards, constraints, fear, and scarcity.

meta_frameworks.name: SURVIVAL
meta_frameworks.description: Robustness, resilience, margins of safety, and avoiding ruin.

canonical_nodes.core_principle: Rare events, randomness, and probabilistic processes shape outcomes more strongly than humans intuitively recognize.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Tail events and random variation dominate long-term systems when enough scale and time exist.
merged_nodes: Luck Dominates More Than People Admit
Rare Events Become Inevitable at Scale

canonical_nodes.core_principle: Systems often appear stable while hidden vulnerabilities silently compound until triggered by stress.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Periods of calm encourage leverage, complacency, and latent risk accumulation.
merged_nodes: Visible Stability Often Masks Hidden Fragility
Calm Plants the Seeds of Crisis

canonical_nodes.canonical_title: Emotional Satisfaction Depends on Expectation Gaps
canonical_nodes.core_principle: Humans evaluate outcomes relative to expectations rather than absolute conditions.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Reference dependence and adaptation change emotional perception faster than material conditions.
merged_nodes: Happiness Depends on the Gap Between Expectations and Reality
Happiness Is a Function of Expectations and Reality

canonical_nodes.canonical_title: Narratives Compress Complexity and Amplify Persuasion
canonical_nodes.core_principle: Stories outperform raw facts because they emotionally compress complexity into intuitive and memorable forms.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Humans process emotionally coherent narratives more efficiently than abstract information.
merged_nodes: People Prefer Stories Over Raw Information

canonical_nodes.core_principle: Rigid reliance on models increases vulnerability when reality diverges from assumptions.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Model simplification hides uncertainty and encourages excessive optimization.

canonical_nodes.core_principle: Systems optimized excessively for efficiency lose resilience and adaptability.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Buffers, slack, and redundancy are removed during optimization.

canonical_nodes.core_principle: Long-term compounding only works when catastrophic loss is avoided.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Time amplifies incremental gains but also amplifies ruin if survival fails.

canonical_nodes.canonical_title: Humans Crave Certainty More Than Accuracy
canonical_nodes.core_principle: People prefer emotionally comforting explanations over probabilistically accurate uncertainty.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Psychological discomfort drives premature closure and overconfident narratives.

canonical_nodes.core_principle: Shared stories synchronize emotional focus and large-scale social behavior.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Common narratives align expectations and influence collective decision-making.

canonical_nodes.canonical_title: Human Desire Expands Faster Than Satisfaction
canonical_nodes.core_principle: Desire scales upward continuously, preventing stable satisfaction from material progress alone.
canonical_nodes.mechanism: Adaptation resets psychological baselines after improvement.

final_replacements_applied.final_node: Positive Change Is Usually Incremental and Low-Visibility
Humans Evaluate Conditions Relative to Reference Points

final_replacements_applied.removed_node: The World Always Contains Ongoing Chaos
final_replacements_applied.final_node: Historical Stability Often Masks Persistent Disorder

ontology_distinctions.distinction: Uncertainty refers to incomplete predictability. Risk refers to exposure to uncertain outcomes.
Risk is probabilistic exposure. Fragility is sensitivity to volatility and disorder.
Psychology shapes individual interpretation while narratives coordinate collective interpretation.
Incentives shape behavior externally while beliefs shape interpretation internally.
